title: EXAMPLES-002: `driver` is uninitialized when `indigo_load_driver()` fails, but `indigo_remove_driver(driver)` is still called
summary: EXAMPLES-002: `driver` is uninitialized when `indigo_load_driver()` fails, but `indigo_remove_driver(driver)` is still called. A missing simulator driver or load error can therefore pass an indeterminate pointer into the driver manager. Initialize `driver = NULL` and call `indigo_remove_driver()` only after a successful load. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
